rationale: Defaults (depth6/eta0.05/rsm1.0/mcw1/alpha0) dominate scout at @3/@5/@10 (the sweep model: eval @1=0.825/@3=0.750/@10=0.543) and held to test @1=0.630 historically. The ONLY lever with eval signal is column subsampling: rsm=0.4 wins @1 (0.845, best in scout) but loses @3-@20; rsm=0.5 is the balanced variant (best @10=0.569). mcw is flat (1=5=10=25). subsample errors under CatBoost; scale_pos_weight>1 corrupts Brier (0.108/0.190) -> both excluded. Probe the rsm 0.4-0.7 region plus gentle alpha regularization to find a config that beats the sweep on test @1/@3 while resisting the H=200 eval->test over-fit. Anchor with defaults so combine confirms the sweep baseline in-window.
